sources.text: Rockstar Games have released 38 new screenshots of Grand Theft Auto 6 , ahead of its release later this month. These screenshots, found on a dedicated launch gallery website Rockstar has created , prompts viewers to scroll down and take in the sights of several high quality in-game screenshots snapshotting all kinds of people, places, and events. These include, but are not limited to, a DJ set in-action, a man and his pitbull looking tough to the camera, a tattooed man getting his hair done (machine gun on hand), and a daring motorbike escape. However, my personal favourite has got to be a lively shot of a dive bar. A band - seemingly called The Rusty Anchor is playing - and some older ladies appear to be having a friendly chat with an open-shirt-wearing geezer enjoying a beer. You can find all the new images in an image gallery below. So look through them at your pleasure: Grand Theft Auto 6 is due to release on the 19th November on PS5, and Xbox Series X/S. A few days prior, Rockstar employees are voting on whether or not they'd like to officially recognise a developer union , as the Rockstar vs IWBG union employment tribunal comes to a close on the eve of GTA 6's release date.

sources.title: A bunch of Grand Theft Auto games will be cheap on Steam until GTA 6 comes out, and only one sucks
sources.text: In the run-up to GTA 6 's November 19 launch, Rockstar has multiple classic Grand Theft Auto games on sale on Steam – and, nearest I can tell, only on Steam. The Nintendo Switch eShop actually has a competing deal for the Grand Theft Auto Definitive Edition Trilogy, which is down 67% to $19.79, but that sale ends in 11 hours from the time of writing. On Steam, several GTA games are discounted until November 19 for an obviously timed special promotion. On Steam, you'll find four games on sale via two actual products: You can't argue with GTA 4 for $6, but you might argue with this version of, in particular, GTA 3. The Definitive Edition Trilogy was famously panned at launch for wonky graphics and poor technical performance that, for the most part, has been patched up in the years since. However, the PC port for GTA 3's Definitive Edition is uniquely poorly rated for reasons that will sound familiar. Here's how the three games in this trilogy compare in Steam reviews: The reception to the two other games in the trilogy improved over time while GTA 3 steadily declined. Much like the day-one reviews, today's Steam players complain of Rockstar launcher interference, bugs, shoddy art, broken cinematics, and performance dips. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more Curiously, perhaps unrelated to the quality of the port, some of today's gamers also don't seem to take too kindly to GTA 3's design sensibilities, it being slightly older than Vice City and San Andreas, and certainly a rawer open-world experience. Thomas Williamson, the CEO of the outsourced trilogy's original developer, Grove Street Games, said earlier this year that the criticism faced at launch was deserved. "I agreed with most of the people's reactions," he said. "But unfortunately, I feel like we did not agree with how the game was released and the response to it from a development side. And I think that would have changed the narrative significantly." However, he added, "at the end of the day, looking at the behind-the-scenes metrics on those games, there were a lot of people who were playing them and really enjoying them." You won't find Grove Street Games listed on the store pages for these games anymore. Previously, Williamson called it a "dick move" for Rockstar to have Grove Street's name removed. He's been with GamesRadar+ since 2019. They've yet to realize his position is a cover for his career-spanning Destiny column, and he's kept the ruse going with a lot of news and the occasional feature, all while playing as many roguelikes as possible. sources.title: Rockstar's having sale on old GTA games on the only platform Grand Theft Auto 6 isn't coming to (ours)
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 finally arrives on November 19, but not for us, no—the big day is only for gamers on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. We're not being completely excluded, though: We can't have GTA 6 in November, but we can take advantage of pre-release discounts on a bunch of older GTA games—deals that, ironically, don't appear to be available on consoles. As noted by GamesRadar , there are four GTA games available in two releases: Grand Theft Auto 3, Vice City, and San Andreas bundled up in the GTA Trilogy for $19.79/£19.79/€19.79—67% off the regular price—and Grand Theft Auto 4: Complete Edition , which includes The Lost and Damned and The Ballad of Gay Tony expansions, for $6/£5.09/€6, a 70% discount. Those aren't the deepest discounts ever seen, but Grand Theft Auto games typically don't venture into the 90% off territory we all enjoy so much—and according to Isthereanydeal.com, this is as low as the GTA Trilogy has ever gone, and close to the mark for GTA 4 . You may recall that the GTA Trilogy Definitive Edition was a mess when it launched in 2021, but it seems to have turned that frown upside-down since then: On Steam, where the trilogy arrived in 2023, Vice City and San Andreas both hold "very positive" ratings. GTA 3 is stuck at a "mixed" rating, which is unfortunate: Glancing at user reviews, it sounds like the game still isn't in perfect shape, but it's also suffering from the fact that it's 25 years old, and was the first 3D game in the series—some jank and roughness was there right from the start. Grand Theft Auto 4: The Complete Edition, on the other hand, doesn't suffer from those shortcomings. It's getting pretty long in the tooth too—it came out in 2008—but represents a shift in design and tone that led the series into what it is today. If you're looking for just one older GTA game to horse around with, this is the one, especially given that it's less than half the cost of the trilogy. As mentioned, these sale prices are currently only being offered on Steam: There's currently no sign of any of them on either the Xbox or PlayStation stores (Fun fact: there actually is no digital version of GTA 4 on the PS Store because Sony didn't start selling full-priced games online until well after 2008). Maybe it's just coincidence, but they do appear to be intentional pre-GTA 6 sales: The discounts are on until November 19, when Grand Theft Auto 6 launches—except on PC. sources.title: Skyrim Game Director Has a Very Specific Wishlist For The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel
sources.text: The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel is probably still a couple years away , and we don't know much about Bethesda's next big RPG. However, the game director for Skyrim has come out with a couple of specific requests for the game. Former Bethesda design director Bruce Nesmith sat down on The Examined Game podcast to talk about his time at the company. But, about 40 minutes into the interview, the YouTuber asked Nesmith about what he'd like to see from The Elder Scrolls VI, and there are two things, better mounts and better ladders. And that latter one is how you can tell that he's a game director. Wanting better mounts in Elder Scrolls is almost universal for fans, as Skyrim doesn't exactly have a great mount system. As Nesmith describes the problem, "you can ride a horse, but that's all you can do in Skyrim. Thats it. You just ride the horse. Well, I should be able to do other things with the horse, too, like maybe fight on the horse, or have it fight with me, or you know, stuff like that." To be clear, Nesmith now spends his days writing novels, and doesn't have anything to do with Sentinel, but it would be cool to be able to have some kind of mounted combat system in The Elder Scrolls VI. For instance, I've been getting back into Monster Hunter Wilds ahead of the expansion, and the way you can use your Seikret to dodge out of boss mechanics and manage your inventory while avoiding attacks is huge, and would be great in other RPGs. But as for ladders, Nesmith request seems odd until he starts to explain the way that ladders limited game design in Skyrim. As he explains, "you don't climb up and down ladders. It seems simple, it seems stupid, but you don't climb up and down ladders, which really limits the art team in terms of how they can do multi-layer things. You know, all the ladders in Skyrim, you click on the ladder, and poof you're at the top. Or you have to climb a stair." Some of that is obviously the limited technology of 2011, but it's apparently something Bethesda tried to solve, before giving up to prioritize other elements of the massive RPG. When Nesmith tried to get ladders solved in Skyrim, he says "to do ladders, you have to deal with a whole host of questions that our programmers very legitimately put in front of us and said, 'you give me answers to these, I'll tell you how much programming time it's going to take to make them.' and that caused problems right there." Even when I sit down and think about it, I can't really think of any game that really nails ladders, and a lot of games have problems with them in one way or another, especially around the era of Skyrim. Nesmith goes on to explain a lot of the specific problems that enemy AI has with ladders, like its ability to decide whether or not to wait for you at the top, or to climb back down the ladder to come after you. These problems have all been solved in one way or another in other games, but I'd hope that Skyrim finds a way to solve the issue as well. Either way, The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel is still a few years away, even though Bethesda is already selling merch . We'll have to wait a bit to see more about the game, but there are some signs about what might be in the game, and that might even include ship combat – or at least I hope. Jackie Thomas is the Senior Tech Editor at IGN and the PC components queen. She's been covering gaming hardware for more than a decade for IGN, TechRadar, Gizmodo, PC Gamer and more. You can follow her @Jackiecobra

sources.title: Skyrim's lead designer has 2 big asks of The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel, and only one of them is something most players have ever thought about
sources.text: The classic children's board game: horses and ladders. Psst, hey kid, what are the big changes you'd like to see in The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel ? Because all have them, don't we? We've all got our big lists for Todd Howard: Five Easy Ways to Turn This Enormously Profitable Ship Around. You know who else has some changes he'd like to see in Sentinel? Bethesda alum and Skyrim lead designer Bruce Nesmith, who recently sat down with The Examined Game and said that the things he'd really like Bethesda to knuckle down on in TES 6 are mounts and ladders. "I'd like to see a much better implementation of mounts," said Nesmith. "That's been a common complaint; I'm not alone in that." But mounts can be hard to get right. "They're really tricky, there's a lot of hard decisions to be made in those. "You can ride a horse, but that's all you can do in Skyrim. That's it, you just ride the horse. Well, I should be able to do some other things too, maybe fight on the horse, or have it fight with me, you know, stuff like that." In fairness, Skyrim does have some fairly rudimentary mounted combat—though players had to wait for it to be added in a patch back in the day—but I suspect Nesmith would like to see something a bit less awkward in future Elder Scrolls games. I imagine a lot of players would echo Nesmith on mounts. I'm less sure they share his concern about ladders, which strikes me as a very charming and very game-designer-y fixation to have. "You don't climb up and down ladders [in current Elder Scrolls games]. It seems simple, it seems stupid, but you don't climb up and down ladders!" But you know what? I'm on board. Not having proper ladders, says Nesmith, "really limits the art team in terms of how they can do multi-layer things. You know, all the ladders in Skyrim, you click on the ladder, poof you're at the top, or you have to climb a stair." Advanced ladder tech has its costs, though. "To do ladders, you have to deal with a whole host of questions, which our programmers very legitimately put in front of us, and said 'You gimme answers to these, I'll tell you how much programming time it's gonna take to make them'. And that caused problems, right there". Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. There are, it turns out, a whole lot of ladder questions that arise if you try to implement them in your game. If two people use a ladder at once, what happens? How do NPCs make strategic decisions about them? How do you create animations and behaviours for characters getting hit while climbing, or dying while climbing? All these things and more pile up, which is why Bethesda decided to spend its time on other stuff, historically. Now, of course, it's not Nesmith's problem, and the man wants his mounts and ladders. Bravely, as someone else who also does not have to design The Elder Scrolls 6, I say give them to him. One of Josh's first memories is of playing Quake 2 on the family computer when he was much too young to be doing that, and he's been irreparably game-brained ever since. His writing has been featured in Vice, Fanbyte, and the Financial Times. He'll play pretty much anything, and has written far too much on everything from visual novels to Assassin's Creed. His most profound loves are for CRPGs, immersive sims, and any game whose ambition outstrips its budget. He thinks you're all far too mean about Deus Ex: Invisible War. sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Nintendo says it isn't planning any more Switch 2 price hikes
sources.text: Nintendo, which unveiled the results of the first half of its fiscal year 2027 earlier today , has now said it has access to enough quantities of memory to manufacture more Switch 2 consoles. As a result, the platform holder does not plan to increase the price of the Switch 2. That's according to Reuters , citing Nintendo president Shuntaro Furukawa. Nintendo, which has so far sold 26m Switch 2 consoles, has already raised the price of the console earlier this year. The price hikes, which took effect on 1st September in the US, Canada, Japan and Europe, saw the console's price increase by $50 / €30 / ¥10,000. Although that was technically the first price hike for the console itself, prior to the Switch 2's launch last year, Nintendo raised the price of Switch 2 accessories in the US as a result of the Trump Administration's tariffs. The reason that would cause Nintendo to raise prices again is the same that already caused rival PlayStation and Xbox to do so: AI-driven, global memory and storage shortages . PlayStation already raised PS5 and PS5 Pro prices , on several occasions . Xbox has likewise gone through multiple rounds of price hikes for its Series X and Series S consoles , with the most recent having taken place in August . That same crisis pushed one of Nintendo's longtime ROM suppliers to exit the business , opting instead to focus on the more lucrative business segments. ROM memory is used in Switch cartridges, though Nintendo hasn't commented on the news. Incidentally, Switch 2 hardware sales have been in decline for several quarters now compared to its banner launch in 2025. Still, Switch 2 sales are tracking ahead of the Switch 1.

sources.title: Nintendo says it’s not planning another Switch 2 price hike
sources.text: Nintendo’s president says it will have ‘sufficient’ RAM as shortages drive up console prices.﻿ Nintendo’s president says it will have ‘sufficient’ RAM as shortages drive up console prices.﻿ Nintendo president Shuntaro Furukawa said during the company’s latest earnings call that it’s “not considering additional changes” to the Switch 2’s price, Reuters reports. The Switch 2 got a $50 price hike earlier this year, bringing its starting price up to $499. Nintendo said in Thursday’s earnings report that Switch 2 sales have dropped 37.4 percent year-over-year. According to Reuters , Furukawa also gave an update on the RAM shortage, saying, “There has been no major change to the memory situation and Nintendo is in a position to secure sufficient quantities.” Earlier this week, one of Nintendo’s Switch 2 cartridge suppliers announced it plans to stop making ROM memory to focus on memory for data centers instead. Demand from AI data centers is driving the ongoing RAM shortages that’s leading to a wave of tech price increases. Microsoft has raised Xbox Series X / S prices multiple times now, increasing the Series S’s starting price from $299 to $499. The PS5 has also been hit with price hikes, taking its starting price up to $649 .

sources.title: Steam Is Having an Early Black Friday Sale on Digital Board Games Right Now
sources.text: As much as many of us would love to be able to just snap our fingers and a table full of our friends eager and willing to play board games would simply appear, reality doesn’t allow that to happen. As the tabletop industry has blossomed and grown in popularity the past number of years, making digital versions of beloved games has taken off as well. And right now, Steam users have the perfect chance to stock their digital Kallax shelves with some amazing deals on digital cardboard. Lasting until November 15, Steam is currently running the Digital Tabletop Fest - hosted by Nomad Games & Monster Couch. The sale features a wealth of these digital adaptations but if you are more of a physical-only type of player, check out our 2026 Black Friday page for more upcoming sale dates. Take a quick peek through the shelves of the sale and you will find some wonderful offerings, including some that we have featured on our “Best of” lists. New games like Monster Couch’s Flamecraft (featured on our Best Board Games for Teens list ) is not only a beautiful title but is a personal favorite with some great resource management and workplace gameplay. Other standouts that we recommend you check out include Dune Imperium (one of our favorite deck-building games ) and Root ( Best War Board Games of 2025 ). With over 120 titles on discount, and also some previews of big upcoming ones like the digital versions of Stonemeier Games’ Wyrmspan, HeroQuest, and Twilight Imperium, you and your friends are bound to find a new game to suck up your time. What better time too, as we enter the season where everyone will be inside more! A perfect time to roll some digital dice. Early Black Friday sales are still rolling out at major retailers and a lot of the best board game deals haven't arrived just yet. That being said, you can already check out Target's early Black Friday sale for deals on various toys and games. The PlayStation sale also has number of digital games to peruse as well. Scott White is a freelance contributor to IGN, assisting with tabletop games and guide coverage. Follow him on X/Twitter or Bluesky .

sources.title: EA is bringing 25 classic PC games to Steam
sources.text: Thanks to the discovery of a ‘physical media vault,’ EA was able to restore Road Rash and six Wing Commander titles for new Anniversary editions. Thanks to the discovery of a ‘physical media vault,’ EA was able to restore Road Rash and six Wing Commander titles for new Anniversary editions. Electronic Arts is launching 25 classic games on Steam, including “Anniversary Editions” of the motorcycle racer Road Rash and six Wing Commander titles. These Anniversary Editions preserve “the original look, feel and creative intent of the game” but also have quality-of-life updates to support modern systems and controls and improve performance, according to EA . The seven new editions were “inspired” by the discovery of a “physical media vault” with “thousands” of Betacam, VHS, and D1 tapes and “other media assets,” EA says. As part of the digitization process, EA was able to recover master FMV sequences and reedited them to restore more than 1,500 scenes from the games. The updated Wing Commander games also officially incorporate some community-made mods. You’ll be able to get the Road Rash and Wing Commander Anniversary editions for $9.99, and the other classic games, including Ultima and Crusader titles, will be available for $4.99. You can grab them on Steam, GOG, and the EA App.

If you're having trouble working out what to do next, I'll explain how to solve the mystery of Goron City in a full walkthrough and guide, taking you through all the steps needed in this section of The Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time. If you're approaching Goron City, you'll need to be prepared against fire. Find out how to get a metal, non-flammable shield in our guide on how to get a Shield and Sword in Zelda Ocarina of Time . When you first reach Goron City in the Ocarina of Time Remake, you'll discover that all the Gorons are miserable and that their leader, Darunia, has holed himself up in his room. The main goal here is to access Darunia and cheer him up . Here's how you do that: With Darunia placated, he'll be willing to give you Spiritual Stone of Fire... Except he doesn't have it. You'll have to go to the Dodongo Cavern and find it there. Fortunately, he will give you Goron Bracelet, which will allow you to pick up Bomb Flowers and throw them! Feel like some side quests? stories.title: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais
stories.summary: The post Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais appeared first on Xbox Wire em Português .

sources.name: Xbox Wire BR
sources.title: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla: a atualização com novo jogo+, novo recurso e muito mais
sources.text: A atualização mais pedida de Assassin’s Creed Valhalla já está disponível no XBOX Series X|S e no XBOX One. A atualização traz diversas novidades empolgantes ao jogo, oferecendo novas maneiras de aproveitar sua aventura viking. O grande destaque é a chegada do Novo Jogo+, um dos recursos mais pedidos pelos fãs de Assassin’s Creed Valhalla . As demais novidades do patch garantem que sua experiência após o fim da campanha e no Novo Jogo+ seja renovada e desafiadora, com recompensas que fazem tudo valer a pena. Confira o que esperar da atualização mais pedida: Conversamos com o designer-chefe de jogo, David Larouche, para saber mais sobre a atualização e como a equipe coloca os jogadores no centro de tudo o que faz. Quais novidades desta atualização são uma resposta direta aos comentários da comunidade? David Larouche : o Novo Jogo+ foi, sem dúvida, o recurso mais pedido pelos fãs. Assassin’s Creed Valhalla é um jogo imenso, mas, para algumas pessoas, jogar uma vez só não basta. Com esta atualização, estamos muito empolgados em permitir que nossos vikings mais dedicados vivam essa aventura novamente, mas, desta vez, com o personagem que tinham ao final da campanha. Como a equipe garantiu que os recursos pedidos atendessem às expectativas dos jogadores? DL : queríamos que a experiência do Novo Jogo+ não fosse apenas jogar tudo de novo; queríamos permitir que os jogadores continuassem aumentando seu poder, percebessem uma progressão em etapas menores e seguissem aprimorando seus personagens. Por todos esses motivos, adicionamos um modo de progressão estendida, mais melhorias para todas as peças de equipamento divino, uma nova categoria de runas e mais de 300 novas opções de bônus de runas que podem ser gravados na Forja de Runas — e todos esses recursos também estão disponíveis fora do Novo Jogo+. Com todas essas novidades, acreditamos que a experiência do Novo Jogo+ incentivará os jogadores a explorar todo o potencial de Eivor. Houve algum desafio inesperado na implementação dessas novidades? DL : acho que o mais surpreendente para nós foi justamente não termos encontrado nenhum grande desafio que nos deixasse sem saber como avançar. Conseguimos reunir uma equipe muito competente de desenvolvedores com experiência em adicionar o Novo Jogo+ a jogos já existentes; o processo de produção foi incrivelmente tranquilo. Há algum recurso que você esteja especialmente empolgado para ver no jogo? DL : com a atualização, transformamos praticamente todos os bônus presentes em itens em runas que podem ser gravadas na Forja de Runas, independentemente de terem sido lançados na experiência estendida, em uma expansão ou até mesmo na Loja. Mal posso esperar para ver como os jogadores vão combinar todos esses bônus e criar os mais variados tipos de sinergia. Tenho certeza de que há muitas combinações poderosíssimas a serem descobertas! Assassin’s Creed Valhalla recebeu sua última atualização de conteúdo há anos. Por que lançar a atualização mais pedida para os jogadores agora? DL : Valhalla pode ter recebido sua última atualização de conteúdo há anos, mas isso não significa que os jogadores deixaram de se importar com o jogo — e nós também não. Sabemos que o Novo Jogo+ é algo que a comunidade deseja há muito tempo e, quando surgiu a oportunidade de finalmente torná-lo realidade, mal podíamos esperar para seguir em frente. No fim das contas, trata-se de dar aos jogadores de longa data mais um motivo para voltar a um mundo ao qual dedicaram tanto tempo e reviver a jornada de Eivor sob uma nova perspectiva, levando consigo boa parte do que conquistaram pelo caminho. O fato de algum tempo ter passado não torna essa experiência menos significativa para nós nem, esperamos, para nossos jogadores. Qual é a importância da comunidade de Assassin’s Creed para a equipe da franquia? DL : a comunidade é extremamente importante para mim e para a equipe. Pessoalmente, acompanho as redes sociais com frequência para ver sobre o que os jogadores estão conversando e, como equipe, prestamos muita atenção aos comentários e às conversas pela internet. Adoramos ver o que os jogadores criam e compartilham sobre nossos jogos. Essa conexão com a comunidade é incrivelmente gratificante e é uma das principais razões pelas quais fazemos o que fazemos. Jogue hoje mesmo Assassin’s Creed Valhalla com a atualização mais pedida no XBOX Series X|S e no XBOX One.

sources.title: PlayStation sees record high player numbers and increased revenue for Q2 2026, and a lot of that success is down to Marvel's Wolverine
sources.text: As part of today's (Thursday 5th November, 2026) financial results, Sony has confirmed that monthly active users, referred to as MAU, across both PlayStation 4 and 5, reached 127 million in September. This represents a seven percent growth year-on-year for the company, and sets a new record high. In Layman's terms, this simply means that more people are engaged with the PlayStation ecosystem now than ever before. And it's not just that there are more people using machines and occasionally booting up their consoles; active play time also increased over the past quarter, too, with total logged play time increasing by four percent, year-on-year. As a result, Sony and PlayStation noted that its Game & Network Services division saw revenue grow by nine percent year-on-year, resulting in operating profit rising by 83 percent year-on-year. Notably, despite its mixed reception , Marvel's Wolverine was name-checked as a driving force for the decent performance over the past quarter - but that shouldn't be a surprise for anyone that's actually been paying attention to how the game performed . The game sold through 2.4 million copies as of 4th November (so, in roughly 50 days). Ghost of Yotei , meanwhile, has sold through 3.3 million since its launch in October 2025. More people playing consoles, and for longer - it must all be good news for Sony right? Well, not all the graphs are showing growth. PS5 hardware sales continue to gradually decline: in the reporting period, Sony sold 2.6 million PS5 consoles, down from 4 million in the same quarter in 2025. But, with 100 million PS5 units out in the wild, and 127 million PlayStation accounts across the whole ecosystem, Sony doesn't seem that worried: instead, the company is now focusing on converting those with active accounts into more viable customers. Elsewhere in the results, we heard from Sony CFO Lin Tao that the PlayStation 6 is on track and "progressing as scheduled" , with "solid progress" expected on the machine in 2027. Regarding those falling PS5 sales, Tao also referenced that, and says it's all part of the natural cycle of console launches and iteration. "Although new PS5 unit sales are gradually declining as expected at this stage of the console life cycle, the PlayStation platform continues to expand and grow in a stable manner," Tao explained. "[Next year,] we intend to make solid progress in preparing for the next-generation platform." It must be encouraging for Sony to see this growth in this quarter, especially after all the bad press and furore around the company's decision to end the manufacturing of PlayStation discs by January 2028 . It seems to be a core part of the gaming audience's understanding of game ownership, the decision has been widely contested as anti-consumer. It's caused a lot of bad blood with PlayStation players over the past six months, but - seemingly, given these results - that has translated to very little material impact on Sony's bottom line.

sources.text: Skip the safe picks – play something daring with Free Play Days! PAYDAY 3 , Nowhere Prophet , BALL x PIT , Deceive Inc , and Age of Wonders 4 are available this weekend for XBOX Game Pass Ultimate, Premium and Essential members to play from Thursday November 5 until Sunday, November 8. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 – DMZ will be available between Friday, November 6 at 12 PM PT through November 11 at 10 AM PT. IXION will have a 2-hour trial from Thursday, November 5 until Sunday, November 8. Additionally, Anno 117 and Crime Boss: Rockay City are free for all XBOX members to try from November 5 until November 8 (XBOX Game Pass Game Pass Ultimate, Premium and Essential membership not required). Scroll down and find and install the games on each of the individual game details page on XBOX.com. Clicking through will send you to the Microsoft Store, where you must be signed in to see the option to install with your XBOX Game Pass Ultimate, Premium and Essential membership. To download on console, click on the Subscriptions tab in the XBOX Store and navigate down to the Free Play Days collection on your XBOX One and XBOX Series X|S. Purchase the game and other editions at a limited time discount and continue playing while keeping your Gamerscore and achievements earned during the event! Please note that discounts, percentages, and title availability may vary by title and region. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 – DMZ For a limited time from November 6 at 12 PM PT through November 11 at 10 AAM PT, get full access to DMZ in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 for free. Infiltrate X01, a former North Korean weapons facility seized by Russian forces, take on new DMZ Orders, and complete Threat Assessments to earn valuable rewards. Fight, loot, and extract with your squad across the full DMZ experience. PAYDAY 3 Put on the mask. Take New York. PAYDAY 3 is the FPS co-op heist fantasy set in the most iconic city in the world. Plan it quiet and fight your way out when it goes loud. From November 4–18, grab the base game for 35% off, with additional savings on select PDLC. Plus, play PAYDAY 3 for free on Xbox Series X|S from November 5–8 during Free Play Days. Nowhere Prophet Traverse barren wastelands and try Nowhere Prophet as part of Xbox Free Play Days all weekend, and you can grab the full game for 70% OFF! Prepare your decks and go on a pilgrimage through the wasteland! Nowhere Prophet is a unique single-player card game. Travel across randomly generated maps and lead your followers in deep tactical combat. Discover new cards and build your deck as you explore this strange, broken world. BALL x PIT BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite. Batter hordes of enemies with ricocheting balls and gather the riches of the pit to expand your homestead, generate resources and recruit unique heroes. Get BALL x PIT today for 50% off – available for a limited time! Deceive Inc Welcome, agent, to Deceive Inc. Go undercover as the world’s greatest secret agents in this multiplayer game of social stealth and subterfuge. Disguise yourself as anyone to blend into the crowd, deploy high-tech gadgets to gain the upper hand, and extract the package before the competition takes it for themselves! Deceive Inc. will be on sale for 90% off during the Free Play Days weekend so be sure to grab your copy! Age of Wonders 4 Rule a fantasy realm of your own design in Age of Wonders 4! Explore new magical realms in Age of Wonders’ signature blend of 4X strategy and turn-based tactical combat. Control a faction that grows and changes as you expand your empire with each turn. Enjoy Age of Wonders 4 for free as part of Free Play Days until November 8. IXION IXION is a city-builder that requires you to be vigilant, to constantly assess and reassess, to learn and adapt. If you and your crew are to endure, you must confront the perils of space, while at the same time uncovering its secrets and extracting its resources. Danger, however, will come from within as well as without; you’ll need to establish, maintain and develop the Tiqqun’s infrastructure while managing the station’s population, deciding how best to answer their pleas so as to maintain their trust in you and the mission. Anno 117: Pax Romana Anno 117: Pax Romana is part of Xbox Free Play Days, so you can try it all weekend for free, and grab the Gold Edition for 40% OFF! Shape the Roman Empire in this genre-defining strategic city-builder game. Build cities while expanding your influence through Roman provinces. Govern using your economic prowess, diplomatic skills, or military might. The Gold Edition comes with 3 DLCs, including the newly released Dawn of the Delta where you discover Aegyptus, expand your empire, restore the ancient Pyramids and much more. Try it today and all progression from the Free Play Days will be saved when you buy the game. Crime Boss: Rockay City Grab your crew and take on high-stakes heists, rival gangs, and turf wars as you rise to become the ultimate crime boss of Rockay City. Choose your difficulty, create your boss, equip your weapons and perks and play missions alone, with bots or with your friends. Take on single missions or complete co-op mini-camapigns in the story-driven Urban Legends mode or randomise your missions with Shuffle mode. Don’t miss out on these exciting Free Play Days for XBOX Game Pass Ultimate, Premium and Essential members! Learn more about Free Play Days here and stay tuned to XBOX Wire to find out about future Free Play Days and all the latest XBOX gaming news.
